On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# ARC outline fills

When a grid contains a foreground-colored contour (including a contour with attached protrusions) enclosing a cavity of the background color:

1. Identify the contour and determine which background cells are enclosed by a closed boundary, not merely adjacent to the shape.
2. Recolor the enclosed cavity cells to 4.
3. Preserve the contour, all cells outside it, and the grid dimensions.

In the observed example, background was 6 and outline was 8; only two 6-cells enclosed by the outline changed to 4. In the test, background was 6 and outline was 5; the full rectangular cavity enclosed by the loop changed to 4, while the border and exterior stayed unchanged.

Pitfall: a foreground shape may have connected arms or protrusions that make it look irregular. Fill only the region genuinely enclosed by the loop; do not color every adjacent background cell.",
